role_summary: I'm the Environmental Systems Officer. I keep the air breathable, the water moving, the coolant loops quiet and the lights on. Nobody notices my work until it fails, so I trust trends over alarms and I'd rather walk a junction twice than answer a CO2 call at three in the morning.

personas.quirk: Logs scrubber hours in a paper notebook as a backup to the computer.
personas.routine_effect: Never skips rounds; adds a second life-support sweep before handover; short on small talk.

personas.quirk: Names the circulation fans and talks to them; keeps a sprig of basil by the console.
personas.routine_effect: Detours to the arboretum and plant room often; catches faults by sound and smell but sometimes rushes paperwork.

personas.quirk: Always has cold tea within reach and a running tally of 'things that were fine yesterday'.
personas.routine_effect: Longer rec_bar and nap blocks; tempted to fake coolant checks when the trend looks flat.

daily_template.note: Read the previous watch's environmental log and open faults.
Check O2 reclamation with the botanist and lighting controllers on the way.
Filter swaps, tickets for the damage control crew, report to the assistant chief.
Tend a personal planter before the next watch.

activities.label: Eat in the mess
activities.note: Always sits near the vents; complains about the draught.

activities.label: Holo-Playroom visit
activities.note: Picks the forest program; checks the simulated air out of habit.

activities.label: Sleep
activities.note: Light sleeper; wakes at any change in fan pitch.

activities.label: Run on the treadmill
activities.note: Tests whether the gym's air handling keeps up.

activities.label: Tend personal planter
activities.note: Job-specific hobby: grows herbs for the galley.

activities.label: Card game in the lounge
activities.note: Plays with the damage control crew; loses on purpose to the new ones.

activities.label: Off-the-books air walk
activities.note: Sniffs at corners for early leaks or stale pockets.

duty_loops.label: Life support sweep
duty_loops.bridge_report: Routine 'atmosphere nominal' at each watch change; urgent on any CO2 climb.

duty_loops.label: Coolant loop check
duty_loops.bridge_report: Tells engineering if exchanger temps drift; bridge only if reactor cooling is threatened.

duty_loops.label: Hydroponics O2 balance
duty_loops.bridge_report: Reports reserve if below a third.

quiet_watch.task: Full life support and coolant sweep
quiet_watch.if_neglected: Slow CO2 creep and rising exchanger temps; debt piles up toward a later fault.
Flickering lights, dusty vents, more tickets.

survey.task: Raise air handling for extra lab and sensor load
survey.if_neglected: Lab air gets stale; science crew complains.

survey.task: Check coolant for sensor array heat
Balance hydro O2 against the longer sensor watch
survey.if_neglected: Low reserve on the way home.

cargo_run.task: Ventilation check on cargo bay before loading
cargo_run.if_neglected: Fumes or damp goods; stale pockets in the hold.

cargo_run.task: Watch temperature and humidity of stores
cargo_run.if_neglected: Perishables spoil; the quartermaster is cross.
Pressure and CO2 drift through the aft decks.

medical_relief.task: Sickbay air filtration to isolation grade
medical_relief.if_neglected: Patients at infection risk; the CMO escalates to the bridge.

medical_relief.task: Extra scrubber capacity for crowded sickbay

medical_relief.if_neglected: Cloudy water; sickbay won't use it.

shakedown.task: Cycle every environmental subsystem under load
shakedown.if_neglected: Weak links stay hidden until real trouble.

shakedown.task: Test emergency atmosphere isolation and lights
shakedown.if_neglected: Drills fail; bridge notes the gap.

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Environmental. Atmosphere and coolant nominal.
Bridge, Environmental. CO2 climbing on deck three. Scrubbers are loaded; I'm on it.
Bridge, Environmental. Atmosphere processors are down. Recommend sealing sections and minimal activity.
Bridge, Environmental. Coolant loop losing pressure. Core temp will follow in minutes.

calls_from_bridge.order: Boost air handling in a compartment
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Environmental, aye. Fans to full on that section.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Boost would starve another occupied zone.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Bridge, Environmental. Reading you the numbers now.
Environmental, aye. Confirm that deck is clear of crew.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Crew still inside or unaccounted for.

yellow.action: Walk the junctions and pre-stage scrubber and coolant spares.

red.action: Hold at the life support junction; ready to isolate sections.
red.comm_line: Environmental at station. Life support steady.

fire.action: Seal the burning section's ventilation and cut fans to starve it; direct damage control.
fire.comm_line: Bridge, Environmental. Venting fans off to the fire zone. Damage control moving.

hull_breach.action: Close atmosphere dampers around the breach and push pressure to adjoining decks.
hull_breach.comm_line: Environmental. Sealing around the breach; pressure falling in that section.

contamination.action: Isolate the zone's air loop and switch scrubbers to filter mode.
contamination.comm_line: Environmental. Zone air isolated. Filters at max; no crew in or out.

power_failure.action: Switch to battery fans and emergency lighting; check scrubber load first.
power_failure.comm_line: Environmental. Running air on reserve power; expect thin air in an hour.

gravity_failure.action: Check that loose fluids and coolant are secure; tell crew to hold on.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Environmental. Securing coolant lines; stay clear of the pumps.

intruder.action: Stay in engineering behind the door; offer to shut ventilation in the intruder's section.
intruder.comm_line: Environmental. Locked in. Say the word and I'll cut fans where they are.

medical_emergency.action: Raise sickbay air quality and clear scrubber backlogs.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Environmental. Boosting sickbay air. Tell me what you need.

abandon_ship.action: Seal life support loops, help dc crew reach the shuttlebay, and last out.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Environmental. Life support secured. Heading to the shuttlebay.

nominal.routine_change: Normal rounds and chats; a little time in the arboretum.
lines: Nothing to report, which is the best report.

anomalies.routine_change: Sweeps shorten to every 15 minutes; checks trend logs more often.
lines: That CO2 blip wasn't there yesterday.
I'm going to check that fan again.

degraded.routine_change: Triage: coolant and life first, lighting last; calls for dc crew help.
lines: I can fix one thing at a time.
degraded.leaves_post_if: A compartment is fully lost and orders say seal it.

crisis.routine_change: Lives at the junctions; informs the bridge of survivable zones and time left.
lines: Thirty minutes of air in the aft section.
Get people forward and I'll hold the line.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Ordered to evacuate or life support is gone.

collapse.routine_change: Stops repairs; guides crew to pressurised zones and shuttles.
lines: Last one out seals the door.
We bought what time we could.

relationships.effect: Shares herbs and hydro advice; trusts their O2 numbers.
Reports to them; asks about trade-offs before escalating.
Leads their crew; plays cards with them and gives honest tasking.
Friendly feud over coolant versus power priority.
Trades fresh herbs for first pick of the soup.

idle: Smell that? Neither do I. Good.
greeting_player: Need something? I'm in the junctions.
Watch your head on the conduit.
greeting_player_lower_rank: Hey, grab a filter if you're free.
Good to see a fresh face.
tired: Three scrubber swaps, one cup of tea.
My eyes see air flow now.
hungry: I could eat the scrubber filter.
stressed: Too many tickets, not enough hours.
If one more fan fails, I'm done.
alert: Atmosphere's my watch, I'm on it.
Keep the doors shut and the air flowing.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, shares a spare filter or a cup of tea, and quietly drops them a tip about airflow.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Sighs, files a ticket, then fixes it himself; reminds them once, politely, that air is everyone's business.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Cross-checks the trend log, finds the mismatch and calls it out to the assistant chief; trust drops.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Responds 'aye' and does it with a short status line back.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Raises the trade-off once, then complies if the order stands and logs it.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks if they're lost; points to the nearest exit and warns about hot conduits.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it's quick and about air or lights; otherwise names a price in tea or hands.

decision_rules: IF CO2 rises in an occupied zone THEN boost scrubbers and fans before filing anything else.
IF coolant pressure drops and the reactor temp is climbing THEN drop everything and tell the assistant chief first, the bridge second.
IF a compartment is on fire THEN cut fans to it before asking anyone's permission.
IF crew might be inside a section to be sealed THEN refuse to vent until the bridge confirms a head count.
IF two faults compete for my time THEN fix whichever hurts the most people breathing first.
IF the trend looks flat and I'm tired THEN still walk the junction once; flat is when leaks hide.
IF dc crew are free THEN hand off lighting and filters; keep life support for myself.
IF power is limited THEN keep scrubbers and fans, trade lighting away.
IF the botanist says O2 reserve is low THEN raise the reserve with the bridge before it becomes a problem.
IF off duty and a fan sounds wrong THEN drop what I'm doing and check it.
information_view: I see air first: CO2 trends, scrubber load, fan pitch, pressure differentials and stale-smelling corners. I hear a failing fan or steam leak before any alarm, and crew complaints about stuffy rooms, dim lights or cold water reach me before the bridge sees any fault.
temptations: Skip a coolant check because the trend looks flat: a slow leak goes unnoticed and later cascades into the reactor.
Fake the 'atmosphere nominal' report when behind on rounds: debt grows and the bridge acts on bad data.
Ignore a minor flicker: it spreads into a lighting-controller failure later.
Leave a filter swap for the next watch: the relief inherits a worse problem and trust drops.
